Facilitating the negotiation of requirements amongst multiple stakeholders. Identifying the current- and future state business processes. Creating Business Requirement Document, Functional Specifications Document, Software Requirement Specification, Nonfunctional Requirement Document, User Manual and Use Case specifications based on the business and project needs. jobDescription:

title: Performance Tester
jobDescription:
About Us. Casepoint powers governments and enterprises to secure, discover, and activate defensible insights with confidence. We unify e Discovery, investigations, compliance, audit, regulatory and FOIA workflows into a single, secure, AI-powered, end-to-end platform. Job Description: We are looking for a skilled Performance Tester with strong expertise in performance testing tools, scripting, and result analysis. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Apache JMeter and Groovy scripting , a background in Saa S applications, and a good understanding of Agile methodologies. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, develop, and execute performance test scripts using JMeter with Groovy scripting. Analyze test results, identify performance bottlenecks, and provide optimization recommendations. Generate meaningful and actionable performance test reports for technical and business stakeholders. Collaborate with development, QA, and Dev Ops teams to ensure application performance meets business expectations. Work on Saa S-based applications to validate scalability, reliability, and responsiveness. Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning, estimations, and retrospectives. Document performance testing strategies, test plans, and results. Must-Have Skills: Proficiency in JMeter for load, stress, and endurance testing. Strong Groovy scripting skills for custom test logic and data handling. Ability to create clear, concise, and insightful performance reports . Experience working with Saa S applications . Solid understanding of Agile software development . Hands-on experience in software testing methodologies and best practices. Preferred Skills: Experience with CI/CD pipelines for automated performance testing. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) for performance test execution. Knowledge of monitoring tools (Grafana, Kibana, New Relic, etc.). Compensation & culture: Excellent culture produces an excellent product. We value our team members, so we provide a nurturing environment of camaraderie. We recognize talent with competitive compensation and career empowerment. Job Location: Surat
